content:
Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a specialized chemical enterprise based in Minhang District, Shanghai, China, focusing on high‑quality laboratory reagents, fine chemicals, and related technical services. Positioned in one of Shanghai’s key science and technology hubs, the company benefits from convenient transportation links, a strong industrial base, and proximity to many universities and research institutes, which supports close collaboration with both academic and industrial partners.

The company’s core business typically includes the research, development, production, and distribution of laboratory chemicals used in analytical chemistry, organic synthesis, life sciences, pharmaceutical R&D, materials science, and other application fields. Its product portfolio often spans organic solvents, inorganic salts, biochemical reagents, chromatography materials, and various specialty chemicals tailored to research and industrial needs. By emphasizing quality control, standardized processes, and compliance with relevant regulations, Meryer aims to provide reliable, reproducible products suitable for demanding laboratory and pilot‑scale applications.

In addition to supplying chemicals, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is generally committed to offering technical support and customized solutions, helping customers select appropriate reagents and optimize their experimental workflows. With a focus on innovation, safety, and environmental responsibility, the company seeks to support scientific research, product development, and industrial upgrading both in China and in international markets, contributing to the broader advancement of chemistry‑related fields.
